name: Elation, Lesser
body:
School enchantment [emotion, mind-affecting]; Level bard 1, cleric/oracle 2, inquisitor 1, mesmerist 1, paladin 1, psychic 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 10 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You fill the subject with joy and energy, granting them a +1 morale bonus to attack and melee or thrown damage rolls, AC, Reflex saves, and skills that rely on Strength or Dexterity. Additionally, the speed of their main mode of movement increases by 5 feet.

Elation

School enchantment [emotion, mind-affecting]; Level bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, inquisitor 2, mesmerist 2, paladin 2, psychic 2, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

This spell functions as lesser elation, except the morale bonus increases to +2, and their main mode of movement increases by 10 feet.

Elation, Greater

School enchantment [emotion, mind-affecting]; Level bard 5, cleric/oracle 5, inquisitor 5, mesmerist 5, paladin 4, psychic 5, sorcerer/wizard 6, witch 6

This spell functions as lesser elation, except the morale bonus increases to +4, and their main mode of movement increases by 15 feet.

If you are using the optional hope and despair rules, all three iterations of elation are considered hope spells.
